purpose: Ten distinct visual styles for logo exploration; opaque concept artboards, not final app-icon exports.

concepts.name: 瑞士字标
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Produce exactly ONE standalone original logo concept on a square artboard, not a mood board or a sheet of multiple marks. Intended brand: DockShell, a native macOS SSH terminal application. The design should be simple and contemporary. Follow this direction's specific visual language and palette precisely. This is a new independent identity direction: do not repeat the earlier teal-and-mint rounded-square app badges. No commercial logo imitation, no watermark, no captions or design labels. Design one original DockShell logo in strict Swiss typographic style. Exact text: "DockShell" (capital D and S, all other letters lowercase). A horizontal wordmark, black ink on a pure white square artboard, no icon, no badge, no border. Custom refined neo-grotesk lettering with excellent kerning and generous whitespace. Subtle custom cuts at the terminals of D and S give identity without hurting legibility. One small restrained square terminal-cursor detail may align with the final l; no other symbols. The wordmark sits across the horizontal center, occupying about 70% of the artboard width and only 15–20% of its height. Stark, quiet, editorial, architectural, modern. Flat black and white only, no shading or texture.

Airy, precise, generous empty space. Form an open entrance from a shallow arch flowing into one short horizontal command line, NOT a D, S or a literal >_ symbol. One tiny copper-colored endpoint is optional. The small mark occupies about 40% of artboard width, centered. Flat linework, no gradients, no shadows, no typography.
